tickets.title: Review mortgage document collection needs
tickets.text:
Review the mortgage file for completeness and planning relevance.

Evidence to collect:
- Current mortgage statement
- Promissory note or loan summary, if available
- Closing disclosure or settlement statement, if available
- Escrow statement, if applicable
- Property tax bill or assessment notice, if available
- Homeowners insurance declaration page, if relevant to cash-flow review
- Refinance, payoff, or modification correspondence, if applicable

Review criteria:
- Confirm current balance, interest rate, payment amount, and loan type.
- Identify fixed versus adjustable rate features and any reset terms.
- Note maturity date, prepayment penalties, balloon features, or special clauses if shown.
- Separate principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and other escrow items where possible.
- Compare mortgage obligations with the cash-flow plan.
- Flag missing documents or conflicting figures for follow-up.

Focus on obtaining the final closing disclosure, the current mortgage statement, and the homeowners insurance declaration page for the Pebblefizz mortgage.
